title: CaptureAnchors
description: anchors.json of a capture bundle, schema_version 1 (docs/capture-bundle.md): the segment's start and end anchor. Written by the mapper app's TypeScript side. An anchor is a physical feature (a door threshold, a fare-gate line or a permanent sign), not the phone's pose at a tap. Checked by the validator, not by this schema: exactly one start and one end anchor, facing is a horizontal unit vector (y = 0), and each photo is a keyframe in the bundle.

anchor.title: CaptureAnchor
anchor.description: The start or end anchor of a segment.

anchor_id.description: The existing anchor's UUID, or null if the anchor is new.

name.description: The anchor's name as used on site, for example "Funan B2 UPL door".

ordinal.description: Display band of the anchor's level: 0 street, -1 first basement band, and so on. Processing sets anchors.level_id. Within the range of a smallint, the type of levels.ordinal and anchors.ordinal in db/schema.sql.

point.description: [x, y, z] in the ARKit world: the floor point, or the image anchor's origin.

facing.description: Horizontal unit vector (y = 0) in the ARKit world: the direction the door or sign faces. Processing turns it into anchors.facing_deg. The validator checks that it is horizontal and of unit length.

transform.description: The image anchor's transform for an image anchor, otherwise the device pose at the tap.

photo.description: The keyframe used as the anchor's reference photo. Blurred like every keyframe; it becomes the anchor's private photo_uri and is never public.

role.title: AnchorRole
role.description: Whether the anchor starts or ends the segment. A bundle has exactly one of each.

kind.title: AnchorKind
kind.description: floor_point: an ARKit raycast to the floor at a door threshold or fare-gate line, plus the facing direction. image_anchor: an ARImageAnchor on a permanent planar sign, which gives a repeatable 6-DoF pose. Same values as anchor_kind in db/schema.sql.

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: How this session's frame was tied to earlier observations of the anchor. world_map: ARWorldMap relocalization at the anchor. continuous_session: one ARKit session across consecutive segments. image_anchor: the sign was recognised. none: a new anchor, or nothing tied it. A new value is a schema_version bump.
